title: Implement Feishu delivery envelope for long replies
acceptance: Long Feishu/IM replies are delivered as a concise digest plus local outbox full content
Markdown-aware chunks preserve order and content without silently truncating details
Outbox manifests include checksums, chunk paths, artifact metadata, and retrieval information
Feishu commands can retrieve full output, chunks, artifacts, and recent-task continuation locally
Existing Feishu send behavior remains backward-compatible where possible
Local mocked tests cover segmentation, manifests, sanitation, digest budgets, TaskCard truncation prevention, and retrieval helpers
A handoff is written under temp/plan_feishu_delivery_envelope/codex with exact verification commands and results
verification: python3 -m py_compile frontends/platform_budgets.py frontends/outbox_store.py frontends/message_delivery.py frontends/fsapp.py tests/frontends/test_delivery_envelope.py
